site.hero.tittel: Disponit does the work in your business — within authority you set yourself.
site.hero.tilbud: Disponit is being built to handle the routine work of your business: payments within approval limits, invoicing and reminders, reconciliation and settlement, deadlines and renewals, follow-up with customers and suppliers, recurring reports, automatic checks against regulations, and key figures computed from actual decisions. The principle is fixed: every action is measured against your policy before it happens — if it is within bounds it is carried out; if not, it is stopped and placed with you.
site.hero.tekst: Every area below is live with customers today.
site.hero.tekst_bygges: The control layer runs today — policy engine, audit log, exception queue and policy administration with four eyes. The first module doing real work — automatic WCAG checks of websites you have confirmed that you control — has passed the acceptance gate and is in operation. The remaining areas are specified and under construction.
site.hero.tekst_delvis: The areas below marked “Available” are live with customers today; the rest are being built.
site.argument.presisjon_tittel: You decide what the agent may do
site.argument.presisjon_tekst: The authority is a policy you manage yourself: amount limits, which actions require attestation, and who may approve. Changes take four eyes, and no button overrides them.
site.argument.plattform_tittel: One place for operations, policy and exceptions
site.argument.plattform_tekst: Decisions, exceptions, policy management and user access live in the same surface. No hunting through four systems to find out why something was done — or wasn't.
site.argument.kostnad_tekst: Put the agent on one area first, with tight limits. Widen it once you see what it actually does. The authority can be narrowed again at any time.
site.arbeidsflyt.styring_tekst: An event arrives — an invoice, a deadline, an enquiry. The agent works out what it concerns and what, if anything, needs doing.
site.arbeidsflyt.policy_tekst: The action is measured against your policy BEFORE it is carried out. If a condition is missing — an attestation, a limit, an approval — it is not done.
site.arbeidsflyt.evidens_tekst: Whatever cannot be done automatically is collected in one queue with reasoning and history. Nothing disappears quietly.

site.hero.punkt.fullmakt: You write the authority. The agent can never step outside it.
site.hero.punkt.stopp: Anything outside the limits stops and lands in one queue with you.
site.hero.punkt.spor: Every decision is traceable afterwards, with its reasoning.
site.tilbud_tittel: An agent that does the work, inside your limits
site.tilbud_note: Start with one area. Widen it once you see what it does.
site.tilbud.fullmakt.tekst: You set the limits: amounts, which actions need attestation, and who may approve. The agent measures every action against them before acting.
site.tilbud.unntak.tekst: Anything that cannot be done inside the limits lands in one queue with its reasoning — not in an inbox. You decide, the agent completes.
site.tilbud.spor.tekst: Every decision is traceable afterwards: what was done, why, against which policy version. Without digging through logs.
site.tilbud.kapasitet.tekst: Work distribution and model choice per area, so volume never comes at the cost of control.
site.problem_tekst: Most tools can perform the task. What they cannot do is show that it was allowed — and stop when it wasn't.
site.problem.manuelt_tekst: Limits and authority live in heads, spreadsheets and threads. Nobody can say for certain what applies today.
site.problem.spredt_tittel: The answer sits in four systems
site.problem.spredt_tekst: Ask why a payment went through, and you assemble the answer from accounting, the bank, email and a note.
site.problem.etterpa_tekst: The mistake surfaces at month-end, not as it happens. By then it has already been carried out.
site.svar_tittel: What you'd ask in a meeting
site.svar.hvem_sv: Businesses that already have rules for who may approve what, and want the system to enforce them rather than hope for them.
site.svar.kontroll_sp: What stops the agent doing something stupid?
site.svar.kontroll_sv: Your policy, enforced before the action. If a condition is missing, the action is not carried out — it stops and comes to you. A person can release that case, but only what your policy has made approvable in advance: the role the policy requires, the ceiling the policy sets, and exactly the condition that stopped it. Everything else stands, and the approval is logged. No button grants itself authority.
site.svar.feil_sp: What happens when it is unsure?
site.svar.feil_sv: It stops. Doubt is treated as refusal, not as a probable yes, and the case goes to the queue with what was missing.
site.svar.data_sv: With us, encrypted, with access control per business: no sharing between customers, no use for anything you have not agreed to. Production gets its own machine, set up before the first customer. Today only staging exists, and it holds synthetic test data — never customer data.
site.svar.start_sv: With one area and tight limits. You see what the agent actually does before you widen its authority — and it can be narrowed again at any time.
site.katalog_tittel: One agent platform, eleven business areas
site.katalog_note: Planned product scope: {antall} modules across four phases. What is available today is listed under “What you get”.

ui.policyadmin.utfall.dokument_avvik: The draft does not match the policy it is being activated as ("meta.policy_id" or "meta.status"). The round is closed — the content is frozen, so a new draft is required.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.utkast_ugyldig: The draft breaks a requirement that applies to every policy activated from now on — it was validated before the requirement existed. Fix the draft and validate again.

ui.policy.flere_aktive: Several policies are active at the same time for this workspace. This is a fault state: the enforced policy cannot be shown until it is resolved. If one of them was created by mistake, it can be deleted here as long as it has never governed a decision.
ui.policy.korrupt_aktiv: The active policy cannot be read — its content is not valid, so the policy cannot be shown. This is a fault state: enforcement rejects decisions for as long as it stands. If the policy was created by mistake, it can be deleted here as long as it has never governed a decision.

ui.adjudikator.feil.attestasjoner_uenige: The adjudicators disagree about this case, so a positive grant is impossible. Reject the case if you believe the takeover should not happen — one rejection decides it.
domenestatus.avklaring_kreves.forklaring: Another account has also proven DNS control of this hostname. The case is being handled by Disponit — no action is needed from you right now.
domenestatus.tilbakekalt.forklaring: DNS control of this hostname has been proven by another account. Verify again if you still control the zone.

ui.unntak.kansellert_alert: Rejected. The related task has been cancelled (human rejection):
ui.unntak.oppdrag_utfort_alert: The task completed before the rejection arrived. Nothing was cancelled — reassess the case with the receipt. Task
ui.unntak.saksarsak.kompensasjon_kreves: The task was performed. The receipt arrived after you rejected the case — when the execution itself happened is not known to the system; it may already have been under way before the rejection reached the module. The module contract says the effect can be compensated. Someone has to do that manually.
ui.unntak.saksarsak.irreversibel_utfort: The task was performed. The receipt arrived after you rejected the case — when the execution itself happened is not known to the system; it may already have been under way before the rejection reached the module. The module contract says the effect CANNOT be reversed.
ui.unntak.saksarsak.reversibilitet_ukjen: The task was performed. The receipt arrived after you rejected the case — when the execution itself happened is not known to the system; it may already have been under way before the rejection reached the module. The task ran without a registered module contract, so the system has no basis for saying whether the effect can be reversed. Someone has to find out what actually happened.
ui.plan.under: Set up fixed, recurring WCAG checks of your verified sites. The plan places orders — every run is evaluated by policy like an ordinary order, and a missed window is never made up.
ui.plan.opprettet_alert: The plan was created as a draft. Activate it in the list below when you are ready.
ui.plan.opprett_feilet: The plan could not be created. Please try again.
ui.plan.handling_feilet: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
ui.plan.feil.hostname: Enter a valid lowercase hostname, for example yourcompany.com.
ui.plan.feil.sti: The path must start with / and may only contain ordinary URL characters.
ui.plan.feil.tidssone: Enter a time zone, for example Europe/Oslo.
ui.plan.feilkode.request_feilformet: The form contains values the service does not accept — check rhythm, day and time zone.
ui.plan.feilkode.bestilling_hostname_uve: The domain is not verified. Verify it under WCAG check → Domains first.
ui.plan.feilkode.bestillingstype_utilgje: This check type is not available for your account right now.

ui.plan.feilkode.ikke_funnet: The plan no longer exists. Reload the page.
ui.plan.alert.aktiver: The plan is active. The first check runs in the next scheduled window.
ui.plan.alert.gjenoppta: The plan has been resumed. Counting restarts from now — missed windows are not made up.
ui.plan.alert.stans: The plan has been stopped permanently. Its history is kept.
ui.plan.pause.gjentatt_uten_resultat: three consecutive runs without a report
ui.plan.tom_tekst: Create a plan above to get fixed, recurring checks.
ui.plan.caption: Your recurring check plans
varsel.plan_pauset: Your recurring check plan has been paused ({aarsak}). Resume it in the portal once the cause is handled — missed windows are not made up.
varsel.plan_gjentatt_brudd: Your recurring check plan has hit the quota limit {antall} times in a row — the checks are ordered, but the policy's frequency limit stops them. Review the rhythm or the quota. The plan keeps running.
site.modul.m56.tekst: Checks websites you have confirmed that you control, and stores the report as evidence.
site.modul.m57.tekst: Reads and ranks up to 5,000 applications blind against the role's requirements — a human decides who moves on, and nothing is sent without a signature.
ui.rekruttering.tabell_caption: Candidates, ranked by points with the current weights

ui.rekruttering.evaluering_avbrutt: The evaluation was interrupted and will not finish. The candidates below are the ones that were assessed — the rest are not coming.
ui.rekruttering.vekter_standard: The weights below are the house defaults, not the role profile's: the evaluation did not record its own. The order is therefore computed from these weights, not from the evaluation's.
ui.rekruttering.ny_rekkefolge: The order has been updated. Now on top: candidate {forst}.
ui.rekruttering.blinding_etikett: Blind evaluation (name, gender, age, address, photo and contact fields are masked)
ui.rekruttering.blinding_av_tekst: The evaluation will see personal details in clear text. The choice is logged with who, when and why.
ui.rekruttering.blinding_begrunnelse_man: The reason is missing — blinding stays on.

ui.rekruttering.blinding_pa_begrunnelse: Blinding turned back on from the recruitment surface.
ui.rekruttering.signer_tekst: {listetype} · {antall} recipients · content {hash}. This sends {antall} emails. Cannot be undone.

ui.rekruttering.feil_utfall: The action was rejected. Nothing has been sent.
ui.rekruttering.usikkert_utfall: We got no answer from the server and cannot tell whether the action was carried out. Try again — a retry repeats the SAME operation and does not create a new one. If the outcome is still unclear, reload the surface to see the server's state.
ui.historikk.under: Every activation is an event: the version, the time, and the attestants who approved it. Rollback creates a new draft that must be validated and approved before it takes effect. How many approvers are required follows the risk class: two when the change expands authority, otherwise one — and never the author alone.
ui.historikk.caption: Versions of {policy}, newest first
ui.historikk.rullbakk_fra_borte: draft from version {n}, which has since been deleted
ui.historikk.velg_begge: Select both a from- and a to-version to see the changes.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_sperret.policy_id_: Rollback is not possible for “{policy}”: the identity does not meet the requirements for new drafts (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at least three characters). The history can be read, but a new draft must be created on a policy with a valid ID.
Rollback is not possible for “{policy}”: the identity is too long for a new draft to fit a version number. The history can be read.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_sperret.ukjent: Rollback is not possible for “{policy}”: the identity is not accepted for new drafts. The history can be read.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_tekst: This creates a draft from version {n}. It must be validated and approved before it takes effect: by two people if the change expands authority, otherwise by one person who did not write the draft. Nothing changes now.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_opprettet: A draft from version {n} has been created. It must pass validation and approval before taking effect — the number of approvers is decided by the risk class when the round opens.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_feilet: The rollback draft could not be created. Please try again.
ui.historikk.rullbakk_uaktivert: cannot be rolled back to — this version was never in force
ui.historikk.innhold_borte: content deleted — the activation remains in the log, but this version cannot be read, compared or rolled back
ui.historikk.feil.rullbakk_kilde_uaktive: This version has never been in force, so it cannot be rolled back to. Reload the history.
ui.historikk.feil.rullbakk_kilde_endret: The version you selected is no longer the same one — it was deleted and re-created with different content. Reload the history and choose again.
ui.historikk.tom_tekst: This policy has no registered versions yet.
ui.historikk.diff_tom: No differences between the two versions.
